name: PPA for Fluent Forms – Paytails Payment Analytics for Fluent Forms
author: SuitePress

sections.description:
Fluent Forms Paytails is a powerful and user-friendly analytics plugin built specifically for users of Fluent Forms, the popular WordPress form builder. If you’re accepting payments through Fluent Forms on your website, this plugin gives you a crystal-clear overview of all payment activities, transaction insights, and revenue reports, all from a centralized dashboard.

Whether you run an online store, accept client payments, or collect donations via Fluent Forms, Paytails brings real-time, actionable data to help you track, analyze, and grow your revenue with ease.

🎯 Why Use Fluent Forms Paytails?

If you’re using Fluent Forms payment integrations such as Stripe, PayPal, Razorpay, Mollie, PayStack, Square, Paddle, or Test payments, this plugin acts as your dedicated analytics dashboard. No more manually checking each form – Paytails consolidates all your Fluent Forms payment data into a simple, visual interface.

Features

✅ Key Features of Fluent Forms Paytails

  1. 💰 Centralized Payment Dashboard:
    Instantly view the total payments received from all Fluent Forms integrated with payment gateways.

  2. 📊 Form-wise Payment Breakdown:
    Access detailed analytics for each form, including: Total transaction count, Total amount received, Real-time performance metrics

  3. 📈 Interactive Visual Reports:
    See your data in intuitive graphs and charts, making it easier to analyze payment trends over time.

  4. 🔐 Secure Data Handling:
    Your payment data is securely handled and never shared outside your WordPress site.

  5. ⚙️ Seamless Integration with Fluent Forms:
    Works out-of-the-box with any Fluent Forms payment-enabled form, including forms using: Stripe, PayPal, Razorpay, Mollie, and other supported gateways

  6. 🧠 Easy-to-Use Interface:
    No technical knowledge needed. The clean, modern dashboard is designed for anyone to use and understand at a glance.

  7. 🚀 Optimized for Performance:
    Built to handle large data volumes without slowing down your WordPress admin panel.

👨‍💼 Who Should Use This Plugin?

  1. E-commerce site owners using Fluent Forms for checkout/payment processing
  2. Freelancers and service providers tracking client payments through online forms
  3. Non-profit organizations collecting and analyzing donations via Fluent Forms
  4. Small businesses looking for Fluent Forms payment reporting without expensive third-party services

📌 USEFUL LINKS
Donate Paytails

📦 Installation

  1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/fluent-forms-paytails or install it via the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Ensure Fluent Forms is installed and properly configured with your preferred payment gateway.
  4. Navigate to Fluent Forms → Paytails in the dashboard to view and analyze your payments.

🚀 How to Use

  1. After activation, go to Paytails under your Fluent Forms menu.
  2. Instantly see your total payment summary.
  3. Click on individual forms to view detailed stats, including total earnings, number of transactions, and date-wise performance.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later

sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Fluent Forms to work?

Yes, Fluent Forms Paytails is an add-on for Fluent Forms and requires the core Fluent Forms plugin to function.

Which payment gateways are supported?

The plugin supports all payment gateways compatible with Fluent Forms, including PayPal, Stripe, and more.

Is the plugin secure for handling payment data?

Absolutely. The plugin uses secure data handling practices and complies with WordPress standards.

Does it work on multisite WordPress installations?

Yes, Fluent Forms Paytails is compatible with both single-site and multisite WordPress environments.
